english.note: Use this when the person's smugness is especially obvious and visibly triumphant.

examples.english: After winning the prize, he spent the whole evening looking smug and showing off.
examples.traditional: 攞完獎返嚟，佢成晚都得意洋洋咁周圍晒命。
